title: Penguin in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- penguin body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='26' ry='26' fill='#3a4a7a'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='17' ry='20' fill='#e8f0ff'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='17' fill='#3a4a7a'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#e8f0ff'/>

  <circle cx='44' cy='34' r='2.6' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='34' r='2.6' fill='#1a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='44.9' cy='33.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56.9' cy='33.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M46 40 L54 40 L50 45 Z' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- scarf band -->
  <rect x='31' y='48' width='38' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ff5a6e'/>

  <path d='M62 54 L74 62 L70 70 L60 60 Z' fill='#ff5a6e'/>
  <path d='M62 54 L74 62 L71 64 L62 58 Z' fill='#ff8a99'/>

  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='91' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='91' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#ffb347'/>
</svg>
